minutes.headline: Planning Board approved ANR plans and a bus-parking waiver, and leaned toward extending the marijuana moratorium to May.
minutes.summary: The board signed several ANR plans, granted a site plan waiver for extra bus parking at 39 Mass Ave with a drainage condition, approved prior minutes, and appointed a member to the open space ad hoc committee. Discussion covered the marijuana moratorium and prohibition timing, a by-right sign amendment, and a draft earth removal bylaw.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board granted a site plan waiver for added bus parking at 39 Mass Ave, on condition that new pavement pitch toward the existing landscaped area.
The board leaned toward extending the marijuana moratorium to next spring and holding a non-binding question at fall Town Meeting; no final vote was recorded.
Motions to approve three ANR plans (147 Fitchburg-side road, 292 Chase Road, 164 White Street) were made; the captions do not make the results audible.
A sign bylaw amendment was carried over to a fall town meeting discussion, to be held when the full board is present.
The board agreed to send a letter stating the leftover driveway apron at the Asian Imperial site is not part of the site plan approval.

why_it_matters: An extended moratorium would keep marijuana businesses from opening in town for longer, and voters would be asked about it at fall Town Meeting.
The bus-parking waiver and the drainage condition affect runoff and paving at a busy commercial site, and the sign and earth removal bylaw drafts could change local rules residents later vote on.
watch_next: Fall Town Meeting: the non-binding marijuana question and the sign bylaw amendment.
The draft earth removal bylaw and regulations, which were discussed but not voted.
